name: After § 33
title: REPORT on the implementation of the Recovery and Resilience Facility
part_text: 33a. Stresses that the Commission’s assessment of the fulfilment of milestones lacks transparency and appears to be politically motivated rather than based on objective, clear criteria with specific deadlines; recalls, in this context, the wide margins of discretion available to the Commission, which itself lacks democratic legitimacy; regrets the fact that, as a result, milestones may potentially be used as instruments of political blackmail against democratically elected governments; underlines that such practices can have a lasting impact on the relationship of trust between citizens and the European Union;
